quotes.text: It seems ridiculous that there would be consumer demand to unlock a car from a phone in the first place. What is the point of all this infrastructure and complexity? So you can be just a little bit more lazy. This sort of tech is both a vulnerability and a waste of human resources and ingenuity.
quotes.author: everdrive
quotes.source: Hacker News — Unlocking any car from X brand in most of the world
quotes.extraction_note: Pithy anti-complexity takedown — 'all this infrastructure so you can be a little more lazy' is a perfect grug-brained observation.
